t: How the Automatic Taxonomy Builder works (Signature)
title: How the Automatic Taxonomy Builder works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Automatic Taxonomy Builder does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature builder grows the tree deterministically: the same collection always yields the same hierarchy because clustering seeds and merge thresholds are fixed and recorded. Each node's placement carries a placement ledger — similarity scores to its parent and siblings at the moment of placement. Curator overrides are stored as graft records layered over the algorithmic tree, so the machine's original growth and the human's pruning both survive. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.

title: How the Automatic Taxonomy Builder works: the deep tour (Signature)

The Signature builder grows the tree deterministically: the same collection always yields the same hierarchy because clustering seeds and merge thresholds are fixed and recorded. The deep Signature taxonomy supports polyhierarchy natively: a subject with two true parents gets two stamped parent links rather than one forced choice.
